overall_goal: Soak the dried mushrooms in boiling water

goals.description: Boil water and pour it over the dried mushrooms
goals.rationale: The person turns on the kettle to heat the water, then pours the boiling water into the jug containing the mushrooms, checking the measurement to ensure the correct amount.

goals.description: Stir the mushrooms to ensure they soak properly
goals.rationale: The person retrieves a fork and uses it to stir the mushrooms and boiling water together, then taps off the excess water and sets the fork aside.
